summary.text: Thomas Chittenden is the Democratic incumbent state senator for the Chittenden Southeast District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
He is a senior lecturer at the University of Vermont and vice chair of the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Chittenden was born in Dunedin, Florida, and earned a B.S. in business administration and management information systems in 1999 and an M.B.A. in 2005, both from the University of Vermont.
His career experience includes work as a systems engineer at Competitive Computing and as a senior lecturer at the University of Vermont.
Chittenden's 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Ethics Committee and the Finance Committee, where he is vice chair; earlier he served on the Senate Education and Transportation committees.
